in_sanskrit.name: Mudavath
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lotus carrier
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mudavath एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Mudavath is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mudh' meaning 'lotus' and 'avath' meaning 'carrier'. This name signifies someone who carries the lotus of enlightenment and spiritual growth within themselves.
